headline: Catch package defects before they reach the leadership pack
capabilities: Freeze file lineage and run completeness checks on arrival
Compare divisions to budget and reconcile the driver bridge
Queue blocking, advisory and explanation items to named owners
Draft the executive summary and hold it until sign-off
outcomes: Caught package defects on the day files arrived
Gave leadership commentary that explains what a flat total hides
Released packages only after every blocking exception cleared
why_try: The demo validates one fictional June package in six questions and shows how a flat total can hide two exceptions that need explaining.

sample_prompts.label: FP&A Manager: Package intake and lineage
sample_prompts.prompt: The June reporting package just landed. What did we receive and where did each file come from?

sample_prompts.label: Financial Controller: Integrity checks
sample_prompts.prompt: Run the integrity checks before anyone looks at the numbers.

sample_prompts.label: FP&A Manager: Variance against budget
sample_prompts.prompt: How did each division do against budget, and which variances need an explanation?

sample_prompts.label: FP&A Manager: Driver bridge reconciliation
sample_prompts.prompt: Does the driver bridge reconcile from budget to actual?

sample_prompts.label: Financial Controller: Exception routing
sample_prompts.prompt: Route the exceptions to the right owners.

sample_prompts.label: Finance Director: Executive summary draft
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the executive summary for the leadership pack.

business_flow: Approved ledger, planning and consolidation extracts
